description: Returns the latest saved walk-forward backtest of one strategy: assumptions, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe and Sortino, maximum drawdown and total return against the S&P 500 (SPY), yearly returns, drawdown episodes and last holdings; include adds the equity curve. Figures are hypothetical and carry a disclosure. Read it once a run has finished; to follow a run use acubic_get_backtest_status.

include.description: equity_series: curves vs SPY (up to 200 points); performance_summary: report rows. detailed includes both.

run_id.description: A finished run of acubic_run_backtest to read.

strategy_id.description: The strategy whose latest saved backtest to read.

name: acubic_get_backtest

config.description: The run's settings; null for results saved before the run configuration was recorded.

latest_holdings_total.description: Holdings at the last rebalance; latest_holdings holds the first 10 in concise.

notes.description: Present only when the run asked for is no longer tracked and the latest saved result is returned instead.

percent.description: Completed share, 0 to 100 (42 means 42%), not a fraction.

rebalance_count.description: Rebalances in the saved result's weight history (entries of its stored timeline); absent when the result has no history.

rebalance_history.description: response_format detailed only: rebalances newest first, with all their weights (fractions, 4 decimals). Cut from the oldest end when the result would exceed its size budget (see rebalance_history_truncated); the card and acubic.ai show every rebalance.

cash_weight.description: Filtered runs: the share held as cash.

rebalance_history_total.description: response_format detailed only: readable rebalances before any cut.

rebalance_history_truncated.description: response_format detailed only: true when the oldest rebalances were left out of rebalance_history to fit the result size.

risk_free_rate.description: Average annual risk-free rate over the window, the rate Sharpe and Sortino used: the 3-month US Treasury bill, or the 10-year Treasury yield when T-bill data is missing (the methodology notes name the source).

status.description: none: the strategy has no saved backtest.

truncated.description: True when latest_holdings was cut to the concise size; use response_format detailed for all.

max_drawdown.description: Zero or negative fraction, -0.31 is a 31% peak-to-trough fall.

equity_series.description: include equity_series (or detailed): the daily curves indexed near 100 at the start, evenly downsampled (first and last kept).

points_total.description: Daily points in the saved curve before downsampling.

oneOf.description: include performance_summary (or detailed): the Backtest tab's Performance summary rows, the strategy beside the benchmark.

best_year.description: Best calendar-year return, fraction; the first year is measured from the start of the run.

end_balance_usd.description: What 10,000 USD at the start was worth at the end of the window.

best_year.description: Best calendar-year return, fraction; the first year is measured from the start of the run.

end_balance_usd.description: What 10,000 USD at the start was worth at the end of the window.

title: Get a backtest result
